name: a command headline gets its old habit struck through
looks: On a black card, a two-line command appears, its second line briefly doubled as if stuttering into place before settling. A beat later, a thick hand-drawn line strikes through the old habit named in that line, cancelling it on screen.
build: The headline settles with a quick double-exposure jitter (a ghost copy offset a few px, fading out as the real line locks). The strike is an SVG path stroked on with strokeDashoffset over 0.2-0.3s, power2.out, angled slightly off horizontal for a hand-drawn feel.
sound: A short stutter tick as the headline settles, one firm scratch hit as the strike line lands.
prompt: State the old, wasteful habit as a bold two-line command on a dark card, letting it settle with a brief stutter. A beat later, draw a thick hand-made strike through the habit itself, cancelling it in front of the viewer rather than cutting to a new line.
